nodes.label: Spec as Definition of Done
nodes.rationale: Spec answers What should exist, How we know it works (ideally an agent-runnable test), and What's out of scope.

nodes.label: ADR 0001: Astro with React Islands
nodes.rationale: Site is content-first: Essays are Markdown, Topics a curated list, most pages need no client JS. Astro gives content collections, schema-checked frontmatter, static output, while React is used for Slides and interactive islands. Cost: page shells/layouts are .astro files, not React.
